g.title: Layer 1
g.text: THE OPEN SOURCE FIREFIGHTER · WIRING SERIES
FIG. 5 · MASTER SHEET · SIGNAL, POWER & FLUID — THE WHOLE BOX, TOP TO BOTTOM · RESIDENTIAL NODE
THIS SHEET IS THE ENCLOSURE. WHAT IS HIGH ON THE PAGE IS HIGH IN THE BOX. THE RED DASHED LINE IS REAL. POWER RUNS LEFT OF EACH VALVE, WATER RUNS RIGHT — THEY NEVER CROSS.
DRY CONTROL SECTION — ELECTRONICS ABOVE THE WATER, ALWAYS
FUSED · ORANGE LOOP — LIVE WITH DISCONNECT OFF
DOOR — OPERATOR CONTROLS & INDICATORS · EVERY BUTTON IS AN INPUT THE CONTROLLER READS
DI BUS TO CONTROLLER — OPERATOR REQUESTS
DRIP SHIELD — SLOPED HORIZONTAL BARRIER · SEALED CORD GRIPS ONLY · THE WET/DRY LAW
WET PLUMBING SECTION — BOTTOM · GRAVITY SERVES THE DRAIN
3/4" INTAKE MANIFOLD HEADER — BASIC, THREE TAKE-OFFS
INSTRUCTIONAL — BUILD TO THE HARDWARE ANNEX · NAMED PARTS LIVE IN THE ANNEX PARTS CATALOGUE · THE REGISTER GOVERNS
